meta.title: Snowflake Partnership
meta.description: Viewnear is a Snowflake Premier Partner and a CoCo Preferred Partner: certified depth, a direct line to Snowflake's own team, and early access to what's next, all behind the data & AI practice we build.

hero.title: A Snowflake <hl>Premier Partner</hl>, and CoCo Preferred Partner.
hero.description: Viewnear holds two of Snowflake's highest partner recognitions. Together they mean certified depth, a direct line to Snowflake's own team, and early access to what's next, all put to work on enterprise data & AI by one accountable team across the Americas.

highlight.title: Two recognitions, and CoCo Preferred Partner momentum to back them

unlocksHeading.title: Faster to value, with less risk and lower cost
unlocksHeading.intro: Certification isn't a logo on a slide; it changes how fast, how safely, and how affordably the business gets to value.

unlocks.title: One plan with the Snowflake team
unlocks.body: We work alongside the Snowflake account team on architecture, funding, and delivery: aligned incentives and one plan, not a vendor bolted on after the fact.

unlocks.title: Snowflake procurement, simplified
unlocks.body: Snowflake charges for the compute and storage actually consumed. Procuring that capacity through Viewnear means simpler commercial terms, with licensing and delivery under one accountable partner.

unlocks.title: Priority roadmap & preview access
unlocks.body: Early access to what's next on Snowflake (Cortex, Openflow, Horizon, CoCo), so new use cases can build on emerging capabilities before they're mainstream.

unlocks.title: SnowPro-certified delivery
unlocks.body: Certified architects and engineers on every engagement. Snowflake is what we do, not one of ten stacks we dabble in, so every engagement gets depth, not guesswork.

comparisonHeading.title: The honest comparison
comparisonHeading.intro: Every leader weighs building in-house, hiring a global systems integrator, or partnering with a specialist. Here's how the options actually stack up.

comparison.inhouse: 6–12 months to hire & ramp a team
comparison.viewnear: 8–16 weeks to first value, demos every sprint

certified.title: Depth that a <hl>generalist can’t match</hl>
certified.body: A Premier Partner is measured on certified people and verified outcomes, not breadth of logos. We know the full Snowflake stack and work hand in hand with Snowflake's own team on every engagement, so the build moves faster with less risk than a generalist or an in-house ramp.
bullets: SnowPro-certified architects and engineers, from design to production

certified.leadershipLabel: The people at the table are the people who deliver.

cta.title: Put a certified partner on it.
cta.subtitle: Tell us where the organization stands with Snowflake (procurement, migration, or AI) and we'll bring the certified team, with Snowflake at the table, to move it forward.
